title: Reproduce: M(3,7) = 51 (a 2007 table prints 48)
statement: There is no choice of one integer from each of the 51 blocks [7i, 7i+6], i = 0..50, such that no three chosen integers form an arithmetic progression. (A valid choice from 50 blocks exists, so this statement is equivalent to M(3,7) = 51, where Brown, Landman and Robertson, arXiv:0706.4420, Table 1, print 48.)

inputs.expected_cost: under 2 CPU-hours with a most-constrained-block-first backtracking search using the mirror symmetry; about 32 CPU-hours for plain backtracking
